font.span:
Share
interactive JupyterLab sessions via a secure link, allowing multiple
users to code and write in the same notebook simultaneously.
New team members can start instantly with a pre-configured environment, including Git access, without local setup.
At IOER, we provide dedicated, 24/7 instances for researchers, offering zero startup time and user-controlled versioning.

font.span: Automated Workflows: Use GitLab CI/CD templates to automatically convert notebooks into versioned, static HTML websites.
Transparent Supplements: Publish code, narrative, and interactive visualizations together, creating rich supplementary materials for papers.
The entire process facilitates the creation of a complete, archivable replication package.
